rows.feature: ModelPicker listbox exposes aria-activedescendant tracking the arrow-key-active option (was: only a visual .active CSS class, no AT-visible signal)
rows.expected: Immediately after opening via keyboard, aria-activedescendant on the role=listbox resolves (via id lookup) to the same element carrying the visual .active class; after ArrowDown moves the visual active option, aria-activedescendant updates to a different id that again resolves to the new .active element; DOM focus stays on the listbox itself (not moved onto an option div), matching the roving-activedescendant ARIA pattern this component already implements for keyboard handling
rows.observed: before: menuHasAttr=true, activedescId="_r_1_-0", resolvedMatchesActiveOption=true, resolvedText="Sonnet 5" | after ArrowDown: activedescId="_r_1_-1", resolvedMatchesActiveOption=true, resolvedText="Opus 5", idsAreDistinctAcrossArrowPress=true, anyOptionIsDomFocused=false, listboxIsDomFocused=true
